Is Azeroth Survivors safe to download?

Last updated: October 29, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

Short answer

The official entry point — Aethus's own domain — has passed Cloudflare Radar scanning with no malicious-content finding. That is a point-in-time technical result, not a lifetime guarantee. The honest answer is: safe from the official source is the supported path; safe from a random mirror is not something anyone can promise you.

Evidence note

The supplied copy reports a previous scan, but no scan URL, scan ID or timestamp was supplied. We have not independently confirmed that verdict or the cited third-party domain-age review. Do not treat either statement as a current security certification.

Why third-party sites get flagged

Independent fan sites around this game have been reviewed as "low risk but not safe" for two structural reasons, not for malware: the domain is very new, and the page carries third-party advertising and sponsored outbound links. The scanner found no phishing, no payment fraud and no malicious payload — but a 13-day-old domain with ad slots cannot be rated the same way as a long-standing official site.

Lookalike warning signs

  • The page offers a .rar download instead of sending you to the developer’s site or an official build.
  • The domain is a near-miss of the game name — extra hyphen, plural, .org or .shop instead of the real one.
  • The site embeds a different browser game on the same page to keep you there.
  • It asks for payment, account credentials or a "verification" download before play.
  • It redirects you away from the developer’s domain when you click Play.

Before downloading

  • Confirm the domain matches the entry point you already know.
  • Do not enter personal or payment details on a fan page.
  • Verify any sponsored outbound link before downloading from it.
  • If you already have progress, note that switching domains can wipe local save data — this is a known consequence of moving between mirrors and the official site.

What the scan actually checked

Cloudflare URL Scanner reports malicious-content verdicts, redirects, network requests and TLS certificate information. Inspect HSTS in the response headers of the specific report; do not assume it was enabled or passed. A valid certificate or HSTS setting protects a connection, not the safety of every file or sponsored destination.

  • Cloudflare URL Scanner documentation

An archive extension alone is not a malware verdict. The developer’s own Windows package may also be an archive; verify the source domain and link chain. This .shop domain is an unofficial guide, not the game host.
